old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and a nominal read might consume events. IPMI v2.0 sections 6.10.2 and 22.8 define an optional Event Message Buffer containing one 16-byte SEL-format record, App 0x35 with no request data, 80h empty behavior, and automatic clearing of the Event Message Buffer Full flag on read. There is no cursor to invent; the irreversible read/ack side effect must be handled explicitly.
disposition_reason: Preserve Master TBD and actual Read Event Message Buffer coverage. On a platform with SPEC-backed support, currently enabled buffer, non-SMI ownership and one independently retained controlled event, capture the full SEL/audit record and 0x31 flag baseline, obtain immediate approval, issue standard no-data App 0x35 once, validate exactly 16 SEL-format bytes and correlation, then confirm only Buffer Full cleared. Do not enable the buffer, generate an event, clear logs/SEL/buffer, substitute an SEL read, or retry an uncertain consuming read.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1009, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1010 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1010 / variant a448354ed11e466f.
IPMI v2.0 section 6.10.2 defines the optional Event Message Buffer as the 16-byte event record that would be stored in the SEL and states it is not overwritten before system software empties it.

Section 22.8 and Table 22-11 define optional App command 0x35 with no request data, completion 80h for empty, and exactly 16 response bytes in SEL Record format. Reading automatically clears the Event Message Buffer Full flag.

If event logging is disabled or SEL is full, the returned record ID may be FFFFh and must not be used as ordinary SEL identity. Correlation therefore uses the remaining record fields and independently retained producer/SEL/audit evidence.

Section 22 states that SMS must not access the buffer when its interrupt is mapped to SMI unless software is explicitly platform-aware because effects are unspecified. Support/enabled/ownership proof is a mandatory gate; absence is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence.

ED-03, ED-13, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24 and ED-26 through ED-30 permit a standard, parameterized evidence-preserving consuming read; ED-33 through ED-38 preserve TBD history and prohibit clear/generation/substitution or retry.

test_case.test_name: Read one pre-captured supported Event Message Buffer record and verify intentional Full-flag consumption
test_case.purpose: Verify the optional standard Event Message Buffer returns the one expected 16-byte SEL-format controlled event, clears its Full flag exactly as specified, preserves independently stored diagnostic evidence and leaves SEL, Receive Message Queue and BMC health unchanged.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/system-interface identity, firmware version, pinned ipmitool/raw collector and protected App 0x2F/0x31/0x35 SEL-record parser
Authoritative platform support and ownership evidence: Event Message Buffer implemented and enabled, interrupt not mapped to SMI, or an explicit platform-aware SMI access specification
One approved pre-existing controlled event already present in the buffer, with full producer/SEL/audit copy retained before read; event generation is separately reviewed and not part of this case
SEL Table 32-1 decoder, expected record type/generator/sensor/event data/timestamp policy, FFFF record-ID handling and redaction/retention rules
Independent BMC/interface/SEL/message-flags observer, point-of-action approval, no-retry rule and incident plan for unexpected or sensitive records
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact active BMC system interface. Prove buffer support and enabled state from platform documentation and `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x2f`; prove interrupt ownership is not SMI, or require an explicit platform-aware SMI contract. If unsupported is proven, record SPEC-backed N/A; do not infer N/A from an empty buffer. Preserve all SEL/audit/log evidence and the full controlled event copy; do not perform the Master log clear and do not create an event in this case. Read `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x31` once and require Event Message Buffer Full bit 1 set while recording all flags. Show the exact target, pre-captured record, expected 16-byte decode and irreversible Full-flag clear; obtain immediate confirmation. Issue exactly one `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x35`. Capture the raw result before redaction; require completion 00 and exactly 16 bytes, decode per SEL Event Record format, apply FFFF record-ID rules and correlate type/generator/sensor/event data/timestamp to the retained event. Read 0x31 once and require bit 1 cleared with Receive Message Queue and unrelated/OEM flags unchanged; verify SEL/audit/log/BMC health. Never enable/disable the buffer, access it when SMI mapping is unresolved, clear buffer/SEL/logs, substitute SEL retrieval for 0x35, generate fault/RAS/event activity, read repeatedly, or retry after ambiguity.
test_case.expected_result: Support, enabled state and safe non-SMI ownership are proven; the pre-read Full flag and independently retained controlled event exist. One approved 0x35 succeeds with exactly one valid 16-byte SEL-format record matching the retained evidence, then only Event Message Buffer Full clears. Receive Message Queue, SEL/audit/log evidence, unrelated flags and BMC/interface health remain intact. A proven unsupported platform is reported N/A, not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative support/ownership, exact target, immutable event copy, immediate approval, one 0x35, completion 00, exactly 16 valid/correlated bytes, correct FFFF handling, pre-set to post-clear bit-1 transition and unchanged unrelated evidence/health. Empty 80h can validate an explicitly planned empty subcase but cannot satisfy populated-buffer coverage. Unsupported without SPEC, SMI ambiguity, malformed/mismatched record, missing pre-copy, source log clear, SEL substitution, event generation, repeated reads, unexpected flag change or retry cannot pass. Missing runtime fixture is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require point-of-action confirmation after displaying buffer support/enabled/interrupt ownership, raw 0x31, the retained event copy, expected decode and automatic Full-flag clear.
Never access when Event Message Buffer interrupt is mapped to SMI unless platform-specific software ownership and behavior are explicitly approved; standard behavior is unspecified there.
Do not enable the optional buffer to manufacture support and do not generate a fault, RAS injection or new event in this case. Use only a separately approved pre-existing controlled event.
Do not clear SEL, logs, message flags or the buffer. Capture immutable producer/SEL/audit evidence before the consuming read per ED-17.
If the returned event is unexpected or sensitive, preserve it in the protected store, stop and escalate; do not read again or act on its content.
No automatic retry after timeout or uncertain completion because 0x35 may already have cleared the Full flag and released the buffer for another event.
expected_evidence: Master TBD snapshot, exact target/firmware/system interface/tool/parser and authoritative support/enabled/interrupt-ownership evidence
Raw pre-state 0x2F/0x31, complete SEL/audit/log baseline and immutable controlled event/producer copy with hashes
Immediate approval, exact no-data 0x35 request, completion/framing and explicit no-retry audit
Protected raw 16-byte response plus redacted SEL-format decode, FFFF policy and correlation comparison
Raw post-state 0x31, unchanged Receive Message Queue/OEM flags, preserved SEL/audit/log/BMC health and independent engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The consumed buffer state and cleared Full flag cannot be generically restored; recovery is the immutable pre-copy and captured raw response. On timeout or uncertain completion, do not resend: read 0x31 once only under the approved verification plan, preserve all SEL/audit/log evidence and escalate. If an unexpected event is returned or ownership conflicts with SMI, stop access, retain the record securely and notify the platform/incident owner. Do not regenerate events, clear evidence, enable/disable the buffer, reset or power cycle the system.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 6.10.2 and 22/22.8, Tables 22-1/22-11 and Appendix G define optional buffer support, the SMI-access prohibition, standard App 0x35, 80h empty result, 16-byte SEL format, FFFF record-ID condition and automatic Full-flag clear.

project_authority: The Project BMC/incident owner proves optional support, enabled state and safe interrupt ownership, selects a separately generated controlled event, defines exact SEL-field correlation and retention/redaction, and approves the one-shot consuming read. Vendor authority is required for SMI/OEM ownership; Project preference cannot make unspecified SMI access safe or unsupported hardware applicable.
